messages:
lucy: Opening PR to tighten the onboarding quickstart: single-file HelloWorld, unify env to RW_API_KEY, add tiny local Docker run, and a short migration table for legacy envs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/924. Can docs/devex review today?
dan: I'll take a look. Quick ask: make the curl example first for fast smoke tests, then show Node/Python SDK snippets.
priya: Agree. Also include a PowerShell example for Windows users and a note about EU host (api.redwood.eu) as a footnote.
lucy: Proposed curl smoke:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-redwood/1.0","input":"Hello"}'
```
dan: Node snippet needs an await on client.generate or it may exit early. Also standardize on const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY }).
priya: I'll patch the PowerShell lines: setx RW_API_KEY "your_key" ; $env:RW_API_KEY = "your_key" and a one-liner curl using $env:RW_API_KEY.
docs-bot: Reminder: add Console -> Settings -> API Tokens path for copying keys and include an opt-in snippet-lint GH Action (node --check, python -m py_compile, go vet) gated by SNIPPET_CI.
lucy: Adding a tiny Dockerfile and build/run example: Dockerfile is 3 lines, run with docker run -e RW_API_KEY=$RW_API_KEY rw-hello. Keeping compose out for now.
dan: Small migration table please (RED_TOKEN -> RW_API_KEY, OLD_HOST -> RW_API_HOST). Put it in a short note near top so enterprise users see it.
priya: Found a stale link to /docs/auth/setup; I'll file a redirect and update the anchor in the PR.
preview-bot: Preview site for PR #924 is ready: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/pr-924 (expires in 7 days).
lucy: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" If reviewers add :eyes: on the PR comment and CI passes I'll merge today and post a short note in #onboarding about the env rename.
